title: Amanpour quits CNN after 43 years on air
title_zh: 阿曼普尔宣布离开CNN，干了43年

image.credit: Photo by Eder Pozo Pérez on Unsplash
image.author: Eder Pozo Pérez

lead: Christiane Amanpour, one of CNN's most celebrated journalists, is leaving the network after more than four decades. Her departure comes as CNN settles into new ownership, though she insists the two are not linked.
lead_zh: 克里斯蒂安·阿曼普尔是CNN最知名的记者之一，如今她将在效力四十余年后离开这家电视台。她离职之际，CNN正被新东家接手，但她强调两者并无关联。

preview_zh: 阿曼普尔1983年以国际采访台助理的身份加入当时刚起步的CNN，后来升任首席国际主播。她周一宣布，自己的节目《阿曼普尔》将于5月停播，她本人则在6月底离开CNN。她在PBS的节目《阿曼普尔与公司》将于今年年底收官。
paragraphs: Amanpour, who joined the then-fledgling network in 1983 as an assistant on the international assignment desk and rose to become its chief international anchor, announced on Monday that she will end her programme Amanpour in May and leave CNN at the end of June. Her PBS show, Amanpour and Company, will wrap up at the end of this year.

In her statement, Amanpour said she had reached the decision to part ways with the network after "many months of thought and a few sleepless nights". Recalling assignments from the first Gulf war to Bosnia, Rwanda, Afghanistan, Ukraine and Iran, she credited the teams and camaraderie with driving the pursuit of facts and humanity, so that CNN could broadcast the truth "without fear nor favor".

The timing is noteworthy: CNN now sits within Skydance, the conglomerate run by David Ellison and heavily backed by his father Larry, an Oracle co-founder and Trump donor. Her exit is not thought to be tied specifically to the new ownership, which some CNN journalists view with scepticism given its perceived closeness to the Trump administration. Even so, Amanpour appeared to acknowledge such worries, vowing to keep rooting for CNN's "history of independent journalism".

In a taped message to viewers, she stressed that she had always been fiercely independent and would remain so, calling this especially important "as we face unprecedented pressures from all sides – political, financial, and also from the rising dangers in the field". Amanpour, 68, has spoken openly about her treatment for ovarian cancer, diagnosed in 2021.

Mark Thompson, CNN's chief executive, thanked her for "43 extraordinary years of remarkable journalism, loyalty and friendship", saying the two had discussed the move for months and that he accepted it was the right moment for her personally and professionally. Amanpour will keep hosting her podcast, The Ex Files, and looks forward to new projects.
paragraphs_zh: 阿曼普尔1983年以国际采访台助理的身份加入当时刚起步的CNN，后来升任首席国际主播。她周一宣布，自己的节目《阿曼普尔》将于5月停播，她本人则在6月底离开CNN。她在PBS的节目《阿曼普尔与公司》将于今年年底收官。
在声明中，阿曼普尔说她经过"数月的思考和几个不眠之夜"才决定与电视台"分手"。回顾从第一次海湾战争到波黑、卢旺达、阿富汗、乌克兰和伊朗的采访经历，她把追寻事实与人性归功于团队和同袍情谊，让CNN能够"不惧不畏"地播出真相。
时机颇值得玩味：CNN如今隶属于天空之舞，这家传媒集团由大卫·埃里森执掌，背后有他的父亲、甲骨文联合创始人、特朗普捐款人拉里·埃里森的鼎力支持。外界并不认为她的离开与所有权变更直接相关，但一些CNN记者因新东家被认为与特朗普政府过从甚密而心存疑虑。尽管如此，阿曼普尔似乎也承认这些担忧，誓言会一直支持CNN"独立新闻的传统"。
在一段录给观众的讲话中，她强调自己一向坚定独立，并将继续保持，称这一点在"我们面临来自各方前所未有的压力——政治、经济，还有一线日益加剧的危险"之时尤为重要。现年68岁的阿曼普尔曾公开谈及2021年确诊卵巢癌后的治疗。
CNN首席执行官马克·汤普森感谢她"43年非凡的新闻工作、忠诚与友谊"，称两人已就此商量数月，他接受这对她个人和职业而言都是合适的时机。阿曼普尔将继续主持播客《The Ex Files》，并期待日后开展新项目。
